name: Arc G3 Extreme

passmark.mapping_note: CPU: exact entry 'Intel Arc G3 Extreme' (only 9 samples; PassMark's description says 'Intel Arc B380', but ARK names the iGPU Arc B390). GPU: 'Intel Arc B390 GPU' entry; most of its samples come from Panther Lake-H laptops (Core Ultra X7/X9) at higher power.

notes: Real SKU name of the stub 'Core Ultra / Arc G3 Extreme (handheld SKU)'; Intel brands it 'Intel Arc G3 Extreme Processor' (Arc G3 Processor Series). Used by the Acer Predator Atlas 8 and the MSI Claw 8 EX AI+. base_ghz is the P-core base (E-core and LP E-core 1.5 GHz). No Hyper-Threading. NPU 46 TOPS. launch_date from TPU; ARK says Q2'26. Intel tdp_w: default = Processor Base Power, min = Minimum Assured Power, max = Maximum Turbo Power (PL2); PL2 is not comparable to an AMD cTDP maximum. igpu.tflops_fp32 = shaders x 2 FLOP x vendor max GPU clock (single-issue FMA; RDNA 3 dual-issue is not counted). PassMark scores mix TDPs and host devices; treat them as a rough guide only.

sources.note: Intel ARK: cores, clocks, power, Intel 18A, memory, Arc B390 GPU with 12 Xe-cores at 2.3 GHz, NPU 46 TOPS
